title: Rivian's Collapse: What a $100 Billion Company Got So Wrong
description:
Rivian's collapse turned a $100 billion valuation into one of the biggest falls in EV history. Backed by Amazon and Ford and hailed as Tesla's fiercest challenger, Rivian burned through billions in cash, missed production targets, and bet everything on a turnaround that still isn't guaranteed to work.

This video breaks down exactly what went wrong for Rivian: the R1T and R1S production disaster, the capital raises that diluted shareholders, the leadership exodus, and the high-stakes R2 launch that's supposed to save the company. This is the real story behind Rivian's stock crash and what it means for the future of the EV industry.
